statement: Under the definitions in source.md and problem.md, the exact truth-value tuple is (E_3,C_3,E_7,C_7)=(0,0,1,1). The negative r=3 values cover every balanced assignment, and the positive r=7 values assert only existence of the displayed balanced Hamilton starter and displayed rainbow simple 7-arc path. No claim is made for any other r or for uniqueness.
contribution: This completely resolves the frozen four-Boolean small-parameter problem: an exhaustive 1296-case certificate excludes r=3 starters, while an explicit exactly checked 28-cycle and development-coloured path establish starter existence and chain compatibility at r=7.
